durableRetirement.problem: WOLF_CI_RETIRE_PAT is scoped to one run; a fresh run silently regained the PAT fallback. selectCredential was also not the only PAT path: private-ci-bridge.mjs reads the PAT directly at 5 sites, and the probe step ran before the retirement step.
solution: Durable ledger on branch wolf-ci-retirement (append-only, never the default branch)
Hydration as the first step after checkout in the execute job, before any PAT-consuming step
selectCredential consults per-run flag OR ledger; either closes the fallback

liveProof.method: run with WOLF_CI_RETIRE_PAT forced empty, reading the real ledger branch

durableRetirement.killTest: Without a ledger, a fresh run retains the fallback (documented as a test). With the ledger, it is denied. The difference is the evidence that the flag alone could not provide.
